# Purpose
This generated header defines string names and numeric indexes for many metric enumeration values used by the `fd_metrics` system. Each `FD_METRICS_ENUM_*` group maps one metric category, such as `quic_frame_type`, `transaction_error`, or `gossip_message`, to a fixed count and to named values that code can use for logging, counters, and labels. The file supports consistent metric encoding across the codebase by giving each value a stable index and a stable text name. Because it is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, it must not be edited by hand, and it serves as a shared source of truth for metric enum definitions.
